Shalini

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1844] How to run a R program which produces multiple outfiles using Hadoop/ RHadoop
parts:
Hi,
while I can not solve specific programming tasks, I have a some general suggestions that you may consider if you are so inclined. One is to learn R first and then combine it with Hadoop, doing both at once seems too hard for  most people, and counterproductive. The other is that I don't know of any way to run an existing program on Hadoop using RHadoop, you need to modify it to use packages in RHadoop to take advantage of Hadoop. 

Antonio
